description_expanded: ABOUT SHORELINE 10: Shoreline 10 has everything you're looking for in a beach house, from private covered parking to amazing balcony views of the ocean you will be spoiled by the comforts of Shoreline 10. The first floor includes the covered parking spot perfect for keeping your car shaded from the Florida sun. On the second floor is an open floor plan with an upgraded kitchen overlooking a bar, dining room table and spacious living room. There is plenty of room for the whole family to gather for dinner and enjoy the views. The townhouse sleeps 6 comfortably with a king master bedroom, queen guest bedroom, and twin over twin bunks. With its convenient location near the beach and thoughtful amenities, this Inlet Beach rental at Shoreline Condominiums is the perfect destination for your Florida beach getaway to 30A. ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. When you stay in Inlet Beach you are never far from the beach, or a magnificent view. To explore 30A, take a bike ride to Rosemary Beach to enjoy the farmers market, discover the new 30A Avenue shops, taste the fine local cuisine, and visit local businesses along 30A. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. For additional shopping and adventure, take a family drive to Pier Park in Panama City Beach or travel to the Sandestin Outlet shops. Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Phillip's Inlet Beach Access behind property PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Steps to the beach. * Gulf Views PARKING: * Free Parking for 1 Vehicle PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. **Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on at all times. At any given point, adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction without notification. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
